Is a Manual Treadmill Worth the Extra Effort?

You’re at the gym facing a line of treadmills . Most are your standard running machine with an electric motor and a flat deck. But there are also a few odd looking machines that arch up in the front and the back, with no buttons on the console and no plug for an outlet. Meet the manual treadmill, also called a self-powered or non-motorized treadmill.
